svg.text: Tag the resources you can identify
Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
Add Environment=Lab, Project=SONIC-Academy, Owner=Learner01 and ExpiresOn with your planned
cleanup date. Select Apply/Save. Do not place secrets or sensitive personal data in tags.
Repeat on the individual Arc resources, VMs, disks and workspaces you create. Resource-group
tags are not automatically inherited by resource objects; a deliberately configured policy can
copy them. Cost Management tag inheritance affects reporting and is a separate feature.
ExpiresOn is a reminder until you build and verify automation that reads it. Start VM on
Connect and autoscale also require actual configuration and permissions.
Check: The actual lab resources carry useful, non-secret tags.
